note: blackAndWhite reads its weight by the dominant channel's index instead of the hue range, so pure blue takes the greens weight, caught by ColorMixTests.redWeightIsForty
colorBalance skips preserveLuminosity, so the result keeps the shifted luma, caught by ColorMixTests.preserveKeepsLuma
colorBalance swaps the shadows smoothstep edges, so shadows weigh fully on white, caught by ColorMixTests.whiteUnmovedByShadows
